topic: File transfer solution for large sample files
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on providing a reliable method for receiving large sample files from an external party. Initially, the need was assessed to determine if the recipient required a simple solution (like browser uploads or WebDAV) due to potential technical limitations on their end. Options discussed included setting up an SFTP service or using a public S3 bucket.

[p1] suggested that SFTP could be enabled quickly and provided cost estimates for maintaining such a service ($216/month). [me] clarified that the requirement was only for a one-time transfer, making the continuous hosting of a service unnecessary.
decisions: The required file transfer solution must be simple, reliable, and suitable for large files.
action_items: Someone needs to confirm the technical capability and preference of the external party (Lord) regarding file upload methods (e.g., browser vs. SFTP).
p1 will check with Lord about the best temporary file transfer method.
